verification.note: Reproduced by reading the code. FilePreview.officeArrowKeys.test.tsx:172 clicks the focusable `<button>outside</button>` (:82). clickOn (:139) focuses it because a button's tabIndex is 0, so document focusin runs excelAdapter.ts:64-70 and clears `active` through setOfficeGridActive(false). The mock's window click listener (:38-40) also sets sheet.focusing=false, so officeGridOwnsArrows (officeGridActive.ts:30) returns false by either path. If you drop the probe term, or drop the onFocusIn clear, that test still passes. No test clicks a non-focusable element outside the grid, and that is the one case the probe exists for (officeGridActive.ts:9-13). A grep over frontend/src finds releaseOfficeGrid only at excelAdapter.ts:4,91 and officeGridActive.ts:23, and officeGridOwnsArrows only in useFileNav.ts:112,119. No test imports officeGridActive, and no test mounts two Excel viewers that overlap, so the ownership guard (officeGridActive.ts:24-25) is never tested. The new test (:188-205) asserts only on `sheet.focusing` (:195-204). It never reads the module-level `active` flag or the probe, and it never presses an arrow after unmount.

specification_compliance: I8: the gate in useFileNav.ts:112,119 calls officeGridOwnsArrows(), which needs both the adapter's active flag and the library's focusing probe. The design matches the invariant, but the path for a click on a non-focusable element outside the grid has no test.
I9/I10: dispose (excelAdapter.ts:84-99) and onFocusIn (:64-70) clear sheet.focusing. The new test pins both.
regression_risks: If the focus-probe term in officeGridOwnsArrows breaks, a click on non-focusable page content outside the grid would leave ← / → stuck, and no test would catch it.
If releaseOfficeGrid's ownership guard breaks, unmounting an earlier viewer could clear the probe or active flag of a viewer mounted after it, and no test would catch it.
test_coverage: FilePreview.officeArrowKeys.test.tsx covers: arrows blocked after a grid click; arrows restored after a click on a focusable outside button; Word arrows; and sheet.focusing cleared on focusin outside and on unmount.
Not covered: an outside click on a non-focusable element (probe path only); two Excel viewers with overlapping lifetimes (ownership guard).
not_verified: I did not run the test suite or any mutation, since I had no shell. The claim that each path alone keeps the test green comes from reading the code only.
I did not check whether the real x-data-spreadsheet sets `focusing` the way the mock does (a window click handler that tests container.contains).
